items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Danny Barker was across the Street at the Louisiana Pavilion... I was in the same area... Danny was right across the street. He had a thing... A fine person.

ctx.x: You hadn't mentioned the World's Fair before. Say a little bit about that.

Well I worked the World's Fair when they had Jo Jones on drums. It was a trio and at one time I had Jackie Williams and I did that. And Danny Barker was across the Street at the Louisiana Pavilion. And so I did about six or seven, seven weeks there at the World's Fair.
